description: This plot illustrates the relationship between Loss and Training Time for two different methods, labeled Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis represents Training Time (s) on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds, with tick marks at regular intervals of 50,000. The y-axis represents Loss on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.05. The Vanilla method is represented by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers. It exhibits a steep initial decline, entering the plot area above the y-axis maximum of 2.75, with its first visible marker at approximately 25,000 seconds and a loss of 2.69, and gradually levels out to end at approximately 2.50 at 245,000 seconds. The SepLLM method is represented by a solid red line with circular markers. It also shows a sharp initial decrease, entering the plot area above 2.75, with its first visible marker at approximately 15,000 seconds and a loss of 2.71, before steadily declining to end at approximately 2.48 at 235,000 seconds. Additionally, the plot includes green dashed lines and star markers highlighting a specific loss value of approximately 2.50, which occurs at roughly 195,000 seconds for the SepLLM line and 245,000 seconds for the Vanilla line, with a horizontal green arrow between these points labeled "1.26×".
